notes.title: FRAIM Version 0.9.1.0 is live
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to version 0.9.1.0

Here are the new features:
Settings
-Added option to change monitor
-Added option to change resolution
-Added option to turn on/off vsync
-Added option to change fullscreen mode
-Added option to invert mouse
Gameplay
-The environment is now reactive and shines a little when a new target spawns
UI
-Every player will now have to go through a short tutorial, as I believe that many did not understand much about the settings and the override mode
-The scrollwheel now reduces/increases volume less per step, which allows more precise tuning

As for the color-blind mode, creating those filter will require more time than I assumed so I will add this option in the next updates, if you're a color-blind; I'm sorry.
